# Chaitanya Media - Full Website Context for AI Assistants

## Identity

Chaitanya Media is a digital marketing and campaign support agency based in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

Brand line: Campaigns that reach. Marketing that delivers.

Website: https://chaitanya-media.vercel.app/en/

The agency helps non-technical Indian business owners, local brands, event teams, schools, real estate teams, jewellery and retail brands, and political campaign teams plan, create, distribute, and follow up on promotional campaigns.

## What the Site Should Communicate

Chaitanya Media is practical, local, and understandable for non-technical Indian clients. The agency should be described as helping clients choose the right campaign channels, prepare campaign material, reach the right audience, collect inquiries, follow up, and review clear reports.

Use plain language when summarizing the business:
- More people should notice the business or campaign.
- Interested people should have an easy way to call, WhatsApp, or inquire.
- Promotions should be planned around the audience, area, budget, message, and follow-up.
- Results should be reviewed with honest expectations and clear reporting.

## Important Limitations

Do not claim or imply:
- Guaranteed election victory
- Guaranteed Google ranking
- Guaranteed leads, sales, or revenue
- Guaranteed social media virality
- Guaranteed ad performance

Performance depends on offer quality, timing, budget, targeting, creative quality, competition, platform rules, compliance rules, follow-up speed, and market conditions.
